This was the deadliest on Saudi soil in over a decade. Fighting between the Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces have been escalating for several weeks. articles.title: Trump touts surprise 'energy ceasefire' – Zelensky says he hasn't seen details, Moscow silent

For Ukraine, it could safeguard vital energy infrastructure. Story by Nicholas Rushworth.

articles.title: El Nino breaks Pacific temperature record as weather pattern intensifies
